evals.prompt: Phân tích BTC cho năm 2026, kế hoạch phân bổ, rủi ro và dự phòng
evals.expected_output: Markdown report with all 10 sections covering Bitcoin analysis
assertions: Output is a .md file named with pattern YYYYMMDD_*BTC*.md
Report contains all 10 required sections
Section 1 has Executive Summary with trend table (3 timeframes)
Section 2 has support/resistance table with at least 5 levels
Section 2 has technical indicators table with SMA 50, SMA 200, RSI, MACD
Section 3 has macro factors table and bull vs bear narrative table
Section 4 has at least 3 scenarios with probability percentages
Scenario probabilities sum to approximately 92-100%
Section 5 has DCA zones table with specific price ranges
Section 6 has risk matrix with at least 6 risks
Section 7 has contingency plans in code block decision tree format
Section 8 has monitoring dashboard table with at least 8 indicators
Section 9 has timeline with specific events
Section 10 has recommendation table for 3 risk profiles
Report includes disclaimer
All price data is sourced from web search (not fabricated)
Report is written in the same language as the user prompt

evals.prompt: Analyze AAPL stock for 2026 with allocation plan and risk management
evals.expected_output: Markdown report with all 10 sections covering Apple stock analysis
assertions: Output is a .md file named with pattern YYYYMMDD_AAPL.md
Report contains all 10 required sections
Section 3 includes earnings/revenue data and P/E valuation
Section 4 scenarios reference earnings and product catalysts
Section 5 allocation considers single-stock concentration limits
Section 6 includes earnings miss risk
Report is written in English (matching user prompt language)
All price data is sourced from web search

evals.prompt: Phân tích Samsung (005930.KS) và kế hoạch đầu tư
evals.expected_output: Markdown report covering Samsung Korean stock analysis
assertions: Output is a .md file
